notes: DSX LE4 FH is a half-length, full-height PCIe Gen2 x8 broadcast SDI I/O developer card (not a display/AV-over-IP endpoint). Manufacturer page (video.matrox.com/en/node/80) exists per search results but returned HTTP 403 on every fetch attempt (bot-blocked); specs cross-verified via Vizrt's official card documentation (documentation.vizrt.com, describes this exact card by name) and a reseller listing at hssl.us that mirrors Matrox's own copy. 13 Mini-BNC (HD-BNC) connectors total on the bracket: 12 individually reconfigurable SDI I/O (max 8 can be the same direction simultaneously) plus 1 REF analog black-burst reference input; adapter cables convert Mini-BNC to standard BNC. Exact SDI bandwidth grade (3G/6G/12G-SDI) is not stated by any accessible source — spec sheets only say "SD to 4K capable" — so grade was omitted rather than assumed. Card also supports up to 16ch AES/EBU audio and 8ch LTC timecode plus RS422 control, but only via an optional add-on "AES Audio Kit" (separate external breakout cables/brackets occupying an extra PCIe slot) — not standard equipment, so not listed as base-card ports. No external power connector exists; the card is powered entirely from the PCIe slot. No rack unit applicable (internal expansion card).

ports.name: IO 1
